'''''Oxyrrhynchium hians''''', also known as '''Swartz's feather-moss''' or '''light beaked moss''', is a [[species]] of moss in the family [[Brachytheciaceae]].<ref name="inaturalist-Oxyrrhynchium hians">{{cite web |title=Swartz's Feather-moss (Oxyrrhynchium hians) |url=https://www.inaturalist.ca/taxa/450656-Oxyrrhynchium-hians |website=iNaturalist Canada |access-date=18 April 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

==Description==
This moss has a highly variable [[phenotype]] in terms of density and leaf shape.<ref name="eflora">{{cite web |title=''Oxyrrhynchium hians'' (Hedwig) Loeske |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=200002288 |work=Flora of North America |publisher=eFloras.org |volume=28 |page=450 |access-date=2026-04-18}}</ref>

==Range==
This plant is found globally. In North America, it is almost absent in the West.<ref name="eflora"/>

==Taxonomy==
''Oxyrrhynchium hians'' contains the following subspecies:
* ''Oxyrrhynchium hians'' subsp. ''rappii''<ref name="inaturalist-Oxyrrhynchium hians" />
* ''Oxyrrhynchium hians'' subsp. ''hians''<ref name="inaturalist-Oxyrrhynchium hians" />
